description: This PHP class 'FormatWithJobCategory' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide formatted string values based on a job category ID. It retrieves a JobCategory entity via the JobCategoryService and returns the category name if found.

classes.name: FormatWithJobCategory
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting a value into a job category name using JobCategoryService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the job category name for a given category ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobCategoryService.
